name: Lena Düpont - Article 1 – alinéa 1 – point -1; Directive (UE) 2015/637 – après le considérant 15 - Am 40
title: REPORT on the draft for a Council directive amending Directive (EU) 2015/637 on the coordination and cooperation measures to facilitate consular protection for unrepresented citizens of the Union in third countries and Directive (EU) 2019/997 establishing an EU Emergency Travel Document
part_text: Amendment (-1) the following recital is inserted: ‘(15a) Taking into account the vulnerable position of victims of forced marriage and marital captivity, and considering the inclusion of forced marriage as a type of exploitation and human trafficking in the revised Union Directive on trafficking in human beings, access to consular assistance and protection for victims of such crimes should be facilitated by the consulates of Member States. Consulates should take into account that such victims may not get any support from their families and that they may need logistical and financial help to return to their Member State.’;
